lines: Saketchandrasingh Pratapsingh Dhandoriya, Promoter Selling Shareholder, is selling 3,736,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹123.29 crore are scheduled on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, per the offer document, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares are estimated at ₹155.04 crore at offer price, so more value may follow for them later.
Gain is unknown: average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents.
